+"""Intent tests for M1-T18 (RISK-03, TC-06): volatility is annualized over 252 trading days."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+
+from risk import Returns, VolSeries, annualize
+
+
+def _returns(d: dict[str, Any]) -> Returns:
+    return Returns(
+        base_date=d["base_date"],
+        dates=tuple(d["dates"]),
+        tickers=tuple(d["tickers"]),
+        values={t: tuple(v) for t, v in d["values"].items()},
+    )
+
+
+def _vol(d: dict[str, Any]) -> VolSeries:
+    return VolSeries(
+        returns=_returns(d["returns"]),
+        window=d["window"],
+        annualized=d["annualized"],
+        values={t: tuple(v) for t, v in d["values"].items()},
+    )
+
+
+def _assert_values(actual: VolSeries, expected: dict[str, list[float | None]], tol: float) -> None:
+    assert set(actual.values) == set(expected)
+    for ticker, want in expected.items():
+        got = actual.values[ticker]
+        assert len(got) == len(want)
+        for g, w in zip(got, want, strict=True):
+            if w is None:
+                assert g is None
+            else:
+                assert g is not None
+                assert g == pytest.approx(w, abs=tol)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_tc06_each_value_scaled_by_sqrt_252_gaps_kept(golden):
+    data, expected = golden("risk", "TC-06")
+    vol = _vol(data["vol"])
+    result = annualize(vol)
+    assert result.annualized is expected["annualized"]
+    _assert_values(result, expected["values"], expected["tol"])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_tc06_keeps_returns_and_window(golden):
+    data, _ = golden("risk", "TC-06")
+    vol = _vol(data["vol"])
+    result = annualize(vol)
+    assert result.returns == vol.returns
+    assert result.window == vol.window
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_tc06_input_is_left_daily(golden):
+    data, _ = golden("risk", "TC-06")
+    vol = _vol(data["vol"])
+    annualize(vol)
+    assert vol.annualized is False
+    assert vol == _vol(data["vol"])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_periods_per_year_sets_the_scale(golden):
+    data, expected = golden("risk", "TC-06")
+    vol = _vol(data["vol"])
+    result = annualize(vol, 12)
+    scaled = {
+        t: [None if v is None else v * math.sqrt(12) for v in vals]
+        for t, vals in data["vol"]["values"].items()
+    }
+    assert result.annualized is True
+    _assert_values(result, scaled, expected["tol"])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_annualizing_an_annualized_series_is_a_value_error(contract_sample):
+    vol = _vol(contract_sample("risk.VolSeries"))
+    assert vol.annualized is True
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"(?i)annualiz"):
+        annualize(vol)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_annualizing_twice_is_a_value_error(golden):
+    data, _ = golden("risk", "TC-06")
+    vol = _vol(data["vol"])
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"(?i)annualiz"):
+        annualize(annualize(vol))
